glossary.definition: 1 UNIT 1 Unit Outcomes At the end of this unit, you will be able to: ) discuss the historical development of atomic structure ) explain the experimental observations and inferences made by some famous scientists to characterize the atom ) list the subatomic particles ) identify atomic mass and isotope terms ) explain electromagnetic radiation, atomic spectra and Bohr models of the atom ) compute the calculations involving atomic structure ) describe the quantum mechanical model of the atom and the related postulates and principles ) demonstrate periodic law and how electronic configurations of atoms are related to the orbital diagrams and can explain periodic trends ) describe scientific enquiry skills along this unit: inferring, predicting, classifying, comparing and contrasting, communicating, asking questions and making generalizations
